title: RouteRisk
description: A native iOS app that compares travel time with historical crash exposure, then shows the tradeoff on a live map. Submitted to CAC NJ07.

cover.alt: RouteRisk diagram comparing a faster route with a lower-exposure route

details: RouteRisk starts with live MapKit route alternatives. It puts travel time beside a relative historical crash-exposure score so you can see the tradeoff before choosing a route.

The scoring layer matches public DVRPC fatal and serious-injury crash records to nearby road segments. The app explains where that data applies and shows a coverage notice elsewhere; the score is context, not a safety guarantee.

I built destination search, route details, and in-app guidance around the map. While a trip is active, RouteRisk can check 511NJ reports near the route and look for an alternative. Optional trip updates and the possible-crash check are separate, experimental features.
